---
title: "Review a Kapso build: the Solution and the record"
sidebarTitle: "Review the result"
description: "What a build hands back: the Solution with its branch, commit, score and evaluator version, explain() and diff(), and the record on disk that Solution.open reads from any process."
keywords: ["kapso Solution", "Solution.open", "solution.json", "explain", "diff", "delivered candidate", "campaign record"]
---

A build returns a `Solution`, and writes the same thing to
`<output>/.kapso/solution.json` every time it returns: finished, paused for
you, or out of budget. From any process, later or elsewhere:

```python
from kapso import Solution

solution = Solution.open("campaign")
print(solution.explain())
print(solution.diff())
```

Before the build has returned there is no solution yet; `open()` says so
and names `kapso watch`.

## What the Solution holds

| Field | What it is |
|---|---|
| `brief` | The brief the build ran, as a `Brief` |
| `campaign` | The campaign directory, checked out at the delivered branch |
| `branch`, `commit` | The delivered candidate; both `None` when no candidate succeeded |
| `base_commit` | The seed commit, `diff()`'s base |
| `score` | The delivered candidate's measurement under the registered evaluator |
| `goal_achieved` | The judge's verdict that the objective was met |
| `stopped_reason`, `stop_detail` | `goal_achieved`, `max_iterations`, `budget_exhausted` (with the dial) or `waiting_for_user` |
| `experiments`, `experiments_total` | Experiments this run, and across every resume |
| `cost_usd` | Model spend |
| `requests` | What you must answer, when `stopped_reason` is `waiting_for_user` |
| `feedback` | The last judgment, in full |
| `evaluator` | The evaluator version the score was measured under; `None` unless the evaluation maintainer is configured (see [Evaluation](/docs/build/evaluation#versioned-the-registry)) |
| `rejected_candidates` | Candidates rejected for touching the evaluator |
| `callback_metrics`, `callback_primary_metric` | Your own evaluator's numbers, when you passed an `iteration_evaluator` |
| `knowledge_index`, `experience_head` | The knowledge index and the lesson-bank commit this build drew on |

`explain()` renders these as a block; `diff()` is `git diff` from the seed
to the delivered commit, empty when nothing succeeded.

```text
Solution for:  Raise the churn model's out-of-sample ROC AUC above 0.85
Campaign:      /home/me/churn/campaign
Candidate:     generic_exp_3 @ 4f1c0e2a…
Score:         0.8614
Goal achieved: True
Stopped:       goal_achieved
Experiments:   3 this run, 3 in all
Cost:          $1.934

Last feedback:
The AUC of 0.861 on the held-out rows clears the 0.85 target …
```

## Three ways a build ends

- **The objective was met.** `goal_achieved` is true, `stopped_reason` is
  `goal_achieved`. Deploy it, or learn from it.
- **The budget ran out.** `stopped_reason` is `max_iterations` or
  `budget_exhausted`; `branch` is the best candidate so far and `score` its
  measurement. Resume with a bigger budget, or change the target. See
  [Resume and budgets](/docs/build/resume-and-budgets).
- **The campaign is waiting on you.** `stopped_reason` is
  `waiting_for_user` and `requests` says what for. Answer through the
  [inbox](/docs/build/inbox); the campaign continues the session that asked.

When `branch` is `None`, no candidate produced a valid measurement; the
experiment branches are still in the directory, and `kapso watch campaign
--tree` shows what each one did.

## The search, branch by branch

```bash
git -C campaign branch         # generic_exp_0, generic_exp_1, …, main
git -C campaign log --oneline generic_exp_2
kapso watch campaign --tree    # each node: score, verdict, what it consulted
```

Every experiment stays checked in; the delivered one is checked out.

## What next

```python
software = kapso.deploy(solution)      # running software; see Deploy
lesson = kapso.learn(solution)         # bank what the campaign taught; see Learn
```

```bash
kapso deploy campaign --strategy local
```
